evidence: paper: |\partial^I \mathcal{T}_n(X,\eta)| \le C_{n,I}\,\zeta(X)\,\delta(X)^{-N_{n,I}} \qquad (X_a < X < X_b,\ |\eta|\le 1). \tag{5.13}  % followed by: "Here C_{n,I}, N_{n,I} may depend on the order and derivative; for n \ge 2 one may take N_{n,I}=0."  \delta(X)=\min\{1,\log(X/X_a),\log(X_b/X)\}, \zeta the flat weight of Theorem 4.6(iv), \mathcal{T}_n=(\mathcal{T}_{n,\theta},\mathcal{T}_{n,z}) from (5.9).
